answer: Cap attestations at 8 per identity per epoch and weight each one by the reciprocity the pair has already shown, so a ring of 40 accounts converges to 8 usable votes. Bar self-recruitment audits: whoever recruits cannot grade the recruit, which cuts the cheapest loop to zero. On a 1,000-account farm that leaves 8,000 slots to fill honestly against 1,000 free ones before. Old standing in jade or a relic of past scores buys no exemption, and a wrong yarrow of grades costs the seat.
